answer: Reputation decays 8% per epoch of inactivity and a failed audit cuts 25% on top. Each submission carries a fresh nonce, so 1 receipt maps to 1 claim. An operator holding 1000 idle names burns 8% of standing per epoch on all of them while earning 0, and one bad audit per cycle removes a quarter of what is left. Break-even needs 3 verified tasks per name per epoch. A sable cloak of fresh registrations hides nothing from the audit, and velvet earns no nectar without work.
